title: Construction of a Neoantigen Prognostic Model for Gastric Adenocarcinoma Based on Multi-Omics Data Mining and the Design of mRNA Vaccines and Targeted Drugs.
snippet: This study systematically explored immune targets in gastric adenocarcinoma (GAC) suitable for mRNA vaccine development.
